description: This file defines enums, functions, and constants related to guardrail providers, including legacy and dynamic provider management, provider mapping, conditional rendering logic for configuration settings, and logo mapping for various guardrails. It facilitates handling guardrail provider data within a React/TypeScript project.

methods.name: populateGuardrailProviders
methods.description: Populates the dynamic guardrail providers object with data from an API response, including legacy hardcoded providers.

methods.name: getGuardrailProviders
methods.description: Returns the current guardrail providers, preferring dynamic ones if available, otherwise falling back to legacy enum.

methods.name: populateGuardrailProviderMap
methods.description: Updates the main guardrail provider map with new dynamic providers obtained from an API response.

methods.name: shouldRenderPIIConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines whether to render PII configuration settings based on the specified provider.

methods.name: shouldRenderAzureTextModerationConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines whether to render Azure Text Moderation configuration settings based on the specified provider.

methods.name: shouldRenderContentFilterConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines whether to render Content Filter configuration settings based on the specified provider.

methods.name: getGuardrailLogoAndName
methods.description: Retrieves the logo URL and display name for a given guardrail value.
